memory.RTS_explanation: Only detached GHC worker-thread TLS stacks remain possibly lost (304 bytes per affected child); exact GHC 9.14.1 Task.c and posix/OSThreads.c are retained. The pure forkOn baseline did not reproduce this timing-dependent TLS observation. No project/native per-client stack is suppressed.
memory.global_SASL_explanation: All retained stacks containing librdkafka allocation frames lead exclusively through rd_kafka_sasl_cyrus_global_init into Cyrus SASL process-global initialization. Tagged 2.16.0 source intentionally omits sasl_done because another application may share SASL. These are not per-message/client owners.
memory.suppression: Only the independently reproduced 20-byte CapIOManager startup baseline is suppressed by exact RTS frames.

controls.header_oracle: Inspect all leak kinds and native allocation stacks, including still-reachable blocks. Stock has no rd_kafka_headers_new retention; deliberate cleanup omission has retained native headers. Earlier mutation replay exit 0 is preserved as evidence that a summary-only oracle can miss conservative GHC roots.

discarded_attempts: Initial include path pointed one directory too deep for <librdkafka/rdkafka.h>; corrected without changing package bounds.
Cabal retained the failed preprocessing timestamp; touching the unchanged .chs forced regeneration, after which the library built.
Printing Text directly in a GHC expression lacked its Show instance scope; explicitly unpacking Text recorded the actual loaded version.
The initial diagnostic smoke exited with native threads still reachable; it is superseded by the bounded GC/native-wait prototype with zero possible leaks.

continued_diagnostic_work.status: partial cohorts not accepted; final replay required
continued_diagnostic_work.private_native_symbols: Stock Linux exports hide three private error-flag setters required by inherited controls; diagnostic-only linker map exports exactly those three without copying opaque objects. Haskell preflight now fails explicitly if they are absent.
continued_diagnostic_work.metadata_fixture: Distinct-field control now selects one broker from a real multi-node frame instead of aborting on broker_cnt > 1. Full native allocation retains its actual owner.
continued_diagnostic_work.runtime_baseline: GHC 9.14.1 minimal main=pure() reproduces the same 20 definite bytes in five CapIOManager allocations. Exact upstream IOManager.c and a ten-frame suppression match only the RTS initialization stack; no project allocation or positive control is suppressed.
continued_diagnostic_work.interrupted_run: The owned VM became unresponsive during concurrent Valgrind and Java cohorts; only that VM restarted. Neither partial cohort is accepted. Remaining cohorts run sequentially.

findings: A pending cancellation at final transaction decoder stage was observed after the worker had already stored a result; fixture handshake must define an explicit interrupt point.

Apache abort-recovery path returns PURGE_QUEUE then abort-required OUT_OF_ORDER_SEQUENCE_NUMBER on its first small recovery record. Independent C API probe reproduces it without Haskell or test interposers.
